Job Description

The Senior Data Analyst, Retention Analytics (Analytics Engineering & Insights) is responsible for building and governing trusted data assets while delivering actionable insights that improve customer retention and business performance. This role combines analytics engineering, metric governance, and business partnering to create a reliable source of truth for customer, retention, and revenue data. The position works closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product, Finance, and leadership teams, leveraging modern analytics and AI-driven tools to enable data-informed decisions.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain scalable, documented, and tested dbt models and data assets.
• Define, govern, and standardize business metrics within the semantic layer.
• Ensure data quality, lineage, documentation, observability, and change management practices are in place.
• Enable AI-readiness through strong metadata, documentation, and governance frameworks.
• Perform exploratory and diagnostic analysis to identify retention trends, risks, and opportunities.
• Partner with business stakeholders to deliver insights and recommendations that drive decision-making.
• Create dashboards, reports, and data products using governed metrics and trusted data sources.
• Conduct code reviews, establish analytics standards, and mentor team members.
• Leverage AI tools to improve analytics, testing, documentation, and workflow efficiency while ensuring output accuracy.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or technical field, or equivalent experience.
• 5+ years of experience in Analytics, Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, or a related field.
• Advanced SQL skills and strong understanding of dimensional data modeling concepts.
• Hands-on experience with dbt, including model development, testing, documentation, Git, and CI/CD practices.
• Experience with metric governance, semantic layers, or metrics-as-code frameworks.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
• Experience working with customer, retention, revenue, CRM, SaaS, or go-to-market data.
• Practical experience using AI-powered tools within analytics or engineering workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Tableau, Power BI, or other data visualization tools.
• Knowledge of semantic layer technologies such as MetricFlow, Cube, LookML, or Snowflake Semantic Views.
• Experience with AI/LLM applications, knowledge management, or agent-based analytics solutions.
• Familiarity with data quality, observability, data governance, and data contracts.
• Experience working with Salesforce data and operationalizing insights within business processes.
• Prior experience mentoring analysts and driving analytics best practices across teams.

What’s in it For You?

• Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
• Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
• Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
• Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
• Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
• Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
• Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here.

More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com.

About Bhanzu
At Bhanzu, we’re on a mission to revolutionize how students learn mathematics — making it intuitive, engaging, and driven by data. Our platform blends pedagogical innovation with deep data insights to deliver a learning experience like no other.

As we scale, we're looking for a Data Insights Analyst who thrives at the intersection of product, tech, and business. If you’re passionate about uncovering insights that directly impact learners and love turning raw data into business and product wins — we want to talk to you.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Analyze product usage and business data to uncover trends, patterns, and growth opportunities.
• Build analytical frameworks to track feature adoption, user engagement, retention, and product health.
• Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Function Leads, and Engineers to drive data-informed decision-making.
• Write and optimize complex SQL queries across relational (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (DynamoDB) databases.
• Automate data pipelines and analysis workflows using Python.
• Design clear, effective dashboards using AWS Quicksight — make data accessible and actionable for all teams.
• Combine data from multiple platforms (including Google Analytics) to maintain a unified source of truth.
• Partner with Data Engineering to improve data quality, accessibility, and governance.
• Present actionable insights to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders in a clear, compelling way.

What We’re Looking For
• 3+ years of experience in data analytics or analytics engineering, preferably in a product-led tech company.
• Strong command of Python for data wrangling, automation, and API-based extraction.
• Advanced SQL skills — capable of writing clean, efficient queries across structured and unstructured data.
• Experience with AWS Quicksight (or similar BI tools) to build insightful dashboards.
• Proven ability to translate data into decisions — with examples of how your insights influenced product or business strategy and funnels.
• Strong communication skills — can tell a compelling story using data for both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, in-office startup environment.

Nice to Have
• Experience in EdTech or other high-growth consumer tech companies.
• Familiarity with Business Function funnels i.e. Sales, Marketing, Operations and co-relation via Product Levers

Why You’ll Love Working Here
• Direct impact: Shape core product decisions and learning experiences for thousands of students.
• Career growth: Opportunity to evolve into senior data leadership roles.
• High ownership: Work autonomously with a passionate, tight-knit team that values insight-driven innovation.
• Dynamic culture: Join our collaborative, learning-focused team at our Bengaluru office.

Headquarters: Poland - Remote

Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Our vision:  A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. 

About the Role:

You'll work alongside diverse, cross-border teams and supportive colleagues who share knowledge and want to see you succeed. We’re looking for a Group Product Manager to lead Klaxoon — the product area responsible for Wrike’s visual collaboration strategy and the evolution of whiteboarding experiences within the broader CWM platform.

In this role, you will define and lead the strategy of Wrike Whiteboards across the key pillars: whiteboard core experience, AI strategy, vertical-oriented use cases, convergence between Wrike and Klaxoon, and customer retention. You will balance innovation, customer stewardship, product unification, and business needs while shaping the future role of visual collaboration in Wrike.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who can combine strong product strategy, people leadership, customer empathy, AI-native thinking, and organizational integration. You will help transform Klaxoon into a world-class visual collaboration tool while developing the PM team into stronger strategic product leaders.

Your Impact:

• Define and drive the Klaxoon strategy: Set the vision, priorities, and roadmap for Klaxoon across the core whiteboard experience, AI strategy, vertical differentiation, and Wrike/Klaxoon convergence into a single seamless product.

• Grow whiteboard adoption and experience: Continuously raise the bar on the Klaxoon product experience to make it a world-class visual collaboration tool, with strong focus on driving adoption among Wrike customers and identifying high-value vertical use cases.

• Enable AI-native R&D: Contribute to building the processes, tooling, and mindsets needed for the R&D organization to work AI-natively, identifying where agentic workflows can change how the team operates and scales output.

• Develop the PM team: Coach, mentor, and grow a team of Product Managers - helping them move from feature ownership to strategic product leadership while building a shared product culture across Wrike and Klaxoon.

Your qualifications:

• Product leadership experience: Proven experience leading product managers or managing a complex product area with multiple teams and stakeholders.

• Strong core PM craft and customer-centric mindset: Deep understanding of product discovery, customer validation, positioning, roadmap strategy, prioritization, metrics, and product delivery.

• Enterprise SaaS experience: Strong knowledge of B2B SaaS and enterprise customer needs.

• Strategic prioritization: Ability to make hard trade-offs across incomparable investments, customer expectations, product convergence, innovation, and long-term strategic direction.

• Cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management: Ability to align teams and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Solution Consulting, and executive leadership.

• People management skills: Experience coaching, mentoring, hiring, developing, and managing performance of product managers.

• AI-native thinking: Practical understanding of AI-native product strategy and ability to identify differentiated AI use cases in visual collaboration.

• Good UX judgment: Ability to balance product power, simplicity, adoption, and customer experience in collaborative tools.

Standout Qualities:

• Experience in visual collaboration, whiteboarding, CWM, work management, or team collaboration products.

• Practical understanding of agentic workflows and AI-native product development.

• Proficiency in French is a strong plus - the team is mostly France-based.

• Visionary mindset and ability to redefine complex product areas for the AI-native future.

About the Role:

• Visual collaboration impact: You will shape the future of Klaxoon as a world-class whiteboarding and visual collaboration experience inside Wrike.

• Strategic complexity: The role requires balancing adoption, AI, vertical strategy, customer retention, product convergence, and innovation in one highly visible product area.

• AI-native transformation: You will help define how visual collaboration evolves in a future where AI changes how teams brainstorm, align, plan, and execute work.

• Organizational integration: You will strengthen the link between Wrike and Klaxoon teams, products, and cultures.

• Exploratory call with a Recruiter

• Meeting with the hiring manager - Product Director

• Panel interview with Product, Engineering, and Design representatives

• Home task

• Final interview with the CPO

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

 Committed
